entities.summary: The Katori Shrine  is a Shintō shrine in the city of Katori in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. It is the ichinomiya of former Shimōsa Province, and is the head shrine of the approximately 400 Katori shrines around the country. The main festival of the shrine is held annually on April 14, with a three-day Grand Festival held every 12 years.
